title: feat(studio): switch an installed app's action on or off on the action, in Studio; retire Setup's Packaged Actions
body:
Fixes #34724

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Clause-②: yes (narrowing: Setup's `nav_packaged_actions` entry and its `automation:packaged-actions` console page retire, and `PackagedActionsPage` leaves the private `@object-ui/app-shell`; widening: new studio-namespace locale keys, an optional `options` argument and the exported `TurnedOffPackagedItemOptions` on `@objectstack/types`' `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem`, and `ActionActivationProjection.disabledPackageOf` plus an optional `platform` argument on `describeDisabled` in `@objectstack/objectql`)
Metadata-protocol: none (no spec schema changes; `platform-objects` serves one fewer Setup navigation item, and one `.describe()` sentence changes)
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` never named the retired entry, page or export (`grep -rli "packaged actions\|packaged-actions\|nav_packaged_actions\|PackagedActionsPage" skills/` is empty)

## 维护者速读

1. 已装应用（只读包）的动作，现在在 Studio 的对象「动作」页和独立动作的条目页上直接有「本部署已启用/已停用」开关，和流程开关同一套组件、同一道门、拒绝原文照出。
2. 平台（内核包）动作在任何地方都没有开关；包列表读不到时也不给开关（偏安全方向）。
3. Setup 的「打包动作」导航与页面在同一个 PR 里下线，旧链接重定向到 Studio（带 `?package=` 时进该包的数据页）。
4. ADR-0146 D4 加了 2026-11-17 的修订条；运行时「已停用」提示语和 spec 的 `disabledActions` 描述改为指向 Studio 里的动作本身，无 schema 形状变化。
5. 已停用的平台动作按您的裁决 A（6944409840）保持原状：不清理、不改门；这类动作的 `ACTION_DISABLED` 提示语改为指向激活接口而非 Studio，changeset 写明逐部署查询方法（`hasMore: true` 即不完整）和恢复调用。
6. Studio 首页每个应用的「已停用 N 项」现在能点到被停用的动作：只停用一个动作时直达它；多个动作、或其中还有流程时，这一行逐个列出被停用的动作名，每个都是链接（最多 3 个，再多给「另 N 项」进动作列表）。链接按动作所在位置跳转：写在对象里的动作没有独立条目页，打开对象的「动作」页并选中它（新增 `?action=` 深链）；不属于任何对象的动作进它的条目页。首页新的「本环境的定制」面板里已停用的动作行也同样跳转。
7. Tier H（ADR 路径，且改动行数 4070 超 3000 人工合并线，其中删除 1954 行）：草稿，等席位 L2 增量与 os-zhuang 批准。

## What changed

**Studio, the vendor action switch (items 1–3).**
- `views/setup/packagedActionLedger.ts` (new): the action ledger's read (`GET /data/sys_metadata_activation?top=1000`, a truncated page is refused), its write (`POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action`, body exactly `{ enabled }`, refusals verbatim through `actionErrorDetail`), and `useActionLedger(packageId)`. The gate is pre-judged by the flow door's own `useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly`. A switch is offered only when `fetchPackages()` lists the package as an app package (`kernel !== true`); a kernel package, an unlisted id and an unreadable list all answer no switch.
- `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx`: on a read-only package (`disabled`) whose route `packageId` is not the org scope, the selected vendor action's detail pane gets the switch bar (`FlowLedgerSwitch`, `testId="action-ledger-switch"`), the refusal line, and a load-error line. A switched-off action is marked "Off" in the list. The package id comes from `useParams()`, so `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is untouched.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: a standalone `action` item on a read-only host package gets the same switch on its page; an object-less action is addressed under `global`.
- `FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx`: optional `hint` and `testId` props (defaults unchanged). The `label` prop of the first head is dropped (no caller passed it; L1 N4).
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx` judges the item's own package (`layered?.packageId ?? areaHost.packageId`), so an app area showing an item a kernel package ships offers no switch (L2 N2).
- New Studio locale keys `engine.studio.actions.ledger.{hint,walled,offMark,loadFailed}` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts` only.

**Retirement (item 4).**
- Removed: `PackagedActionsPage.tsx`, `PackagedActionsSection.tsx` and their two tests; the `automation:packaged-actions` registration in `builtinComponents.tsx`; the `PackagedActionsPage` export in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `index.ts`; `nav_packaged_actions` (and the now-empty `group_apps` contribution) in `setup-nav.contributions.ts`, with its 11 translation lines and source hashes.
- `packagedActions.ts` keeps only what the ledger switch reads (`readDataRecords`, `ledgerPageTruncated`, `readActionActivation`, `standaloneActionObjectName`, the two constants).
- `AppContent.tsx`: `/apps/setup/component/automation/packaged-actions` redirects through `packagedActionsStudioPath` (`setupMetadataRedirect.ts`).
- `nav_packaged_actions` joins the dead-key tombstone list.

**Studio landing (item 5).**
- `packageCustomizations-io.ts`: `fetchPackageCustomizationCounts` also returns `switchedOffActions`, the names of the switched-off items the customization read (`GET /packages/:id/customizations`) types `action`.
- `BuilderLanding.tsx`: the "N switched off" count opens the action's page (`/studio/<pkg>/metadata/action/<name>`) when it is one action, the action list (`/studio/<pkg>/metadata/action`) when it is several, and Automations when flows are among them (unchanged). Whenever the count does not land on an action, the line names each switched-off action as a link to its page, three at most, then a "+N more" link to the list. The action list marks no switched-off row, which is why the names are drawn.
- Where an action link goes (`switchedOffActionTargets.ts`, new; L2 M1 on d6b8707b0a): the ledger row names no object, so the landing reads the app's objects once (`list('object', { packageId })`, only when something switched off is an action) and maps each action name to the object whose served `actions[]` holds it. An action an object holds opens on that object's Actions view, `/studio/<pkg>/data?surface=object:<object>&action=<name>`: an action declared inside its object has no item page (`GET /meta/action/<name>` answers 404) and its switch is on that view. Any other action opens its item page. A failed object read falls back to the item page.
- `useSurfaceDeepLink.ts`: `DESIGNER_SURFACE_ACTION_PARAM` (`action`) and `useSurfaceActionDeepLink`, read once at mount. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (Data pillar only, one hook call) opens the deep-linked object's Actions view on that action through the existing `showObjTarget` (the refusal strip's "Show me" path).
- After #34825 merged: `customizationCountsOf` takes `{ counts, switchedOff }` and returns `switchedOffActions` too. The landing keeps #34825's single customization read, and its "Customizations in this environment" panel links switched-off action rows the same way (`customizationRowsOf(app, read, actionObjects)`).
- New Studio keys `engine.studio.landing.customizations.{switchedOffActionsLead,switchedOffActionsMore,switchedOffActionsTitle}` (en, zh).

**Docs and pins (item 6).**
- ADR-0146: the Status line records the in-place amendment (2026-11-17, with the maintainer's words and ruling 6944409840), D9's action paragraph reads the switch in Studio, and D4 gains a dated amendment bullet (L2 S1).
- Changeset: a **BREAKING** banner for administrators and links that used the retired page (L2 S2), and the amended Clause-② line above.
- `packages/types` `packaged-item-turned-off.ts`: the action's remedy now reads "on the action in its package in Studio". Pins updated in `types`, `objectql`, `runtime` and two dogfood tests.
- `packages/spec` `protocol.zod.ts`: the `disabledActions` description names the activation door, "for example on the action in Studio", so it holds for a platform action too (L2 N1); `content/docs/references/api/{app-bundle,protocol}.mdx` regenerated by `pnpm gen:docs`.
- QA checklist items `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch`, `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board`, `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` (47 entries) and `RUNNER.md`; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exit 0.
- Pins rewritten: `setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts`, `setup-packages-door.test.ts`, `sys-metadata-activation.object.test.ts`, `packages/cli/test/setup-landing-audience.pin.test.ts` (no Packaged Actions entry is served; an officer and a ledger reader both land on `nav_users`; the admin lands on `nav_system_overview`), `noRetiredSetupLink-28578.test.ts`, `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578.test.tsx`.

## Before / after (live, showcase dev boot, admin)

Measured on this branch over `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4731` and the console's Vite server with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Playwright driving the browser.

| # | Reading | Before (main) | After (this branch) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Studio › Showcase › Task › Actions › Mark Done | no switch; the switch lived in Setup › Packaged Actions | `action-ledger-switch` `aria-checked=true`, "Switched on for this deployment"; one click sends `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/showcase_task/showcase_mark_done` `{"enabled":false}`, reads "Switched off for this deployment", the list row shows "Off", the ledger gains `{action, showcase_mark_done, com.example.showcase, active:false}`; after a reload it still reads off; Reopen still reads on |
| 2 | Studio › All metadata › action `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` (object-less) | no switch | switch on; flip sends `POST …/_activation/global/showcase_portfolio_snapshot` `{"enabled":false}`; ledger row written |
| 3 | Studio › Authentication & Identity (`com.objectstack.plugin-auth`, kernel) › User › Actions › Invite User | no switch | no switch, no switch bar (control: the 21 actions and the Invite User inspector render) |
| 4 | Setup navigation | "Packaged Actions" entry | no "Packaged Actions" text anywhere; Setup opens on System Overview |
| 4 | `/apps/setup/component/automation/packaged-actions` | the page | redirects to `/studio` |
| 4 | `…/packaged-actions?package=com.example.showcase` | the page, filtered | redirects to `/studio/com.example.showcase/data?package=com.example.showcase` |

Both switches were flipped back on through the UI at the end; the ledger ended with both rows `active: true`.

**Studio landing (item 5)**, read live on head `d6b8707b0a` the same way (`i5-*` shots in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34724-live/`):

| Ledger | Landing line (Showcase) | Click | Lands on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mark Done off | "0 customized, 1 switched off"; the count's href is `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/action/showcase_mark_done` | the count | that action's page; `action-ledger-switch` `aria-checked=false`, "Switched off for this deployment" |
| Mark Done and Archive off | "0 customized, 2 switched off, Actions: showcase_archive_task, showcase_mark_done"; the count opens `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/action` | `showcase_mark_done` | that action's page; switch reads off |
| both back on | "No changes yet"; no switched-off link | n/a | n/a |

A first draft that sent several actions to the action list alone was dropped after this reading: the list (72 actions) marks none of them.

**An action declared inside its object** (L2 M1). Read on `26ad7aa00` (the M1 commit, before the merge of main; the landing code it read is unchanged since except the panel fold-in) with a local, uncommitted rig: one action added to `showcase_task`'s own `actions[]`, reverted after the reading (`i5e-*` shots).

| Reading | Result |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/meta/action/showcase_embedded_probe?package=com.example.showcase` | 404: no item page |
| Switched off (`POST …/_activation/showcase_task/showcase_embedded_probe`), landing | "0 customized, 1 switched off"; count href `/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object%3Ashowcase_task&action=showcase_embedded_probe` |
| Click | Task › Actions, "Embedded Probe" selected (inspector label "Embedded Probe"), list row marked Off, `action-ledger-switch` `aria-checked=false` |
| Plus `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` (object-less) switched off | "0 customized, 2 switched off, Actions: showcase_embedded_probe, showcase_portfolio_snapshot"; the first opens Task › Actions on it, the second its item page; both switches read off |
| Both back on | "No changes yet" |

**Record page and walled state** (L1 M1): read live on this head in PR comment 6946293120, shots in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34724-live/`. With Mark Done switched off in Studio, the `showcase_task` record page drops the button, a direct `POST` answers 409 `ACTION_DISABLED` with the Studio sentence and nothing runs, and switching it back on brings the button back. The walled state was read with a posture stand-in (rewritten `auth/config` and `get-session` responses), not a group-posture boot. A non-operator gets a disabled switch with the reason, and a click sends no POST; the operator gets a live switch.

## Tests

- New `ObjectActionsPanel.ledgerSwitch-34724.test.tsx` (11 tests): ledger binding, off row plus list mark, flip body, verbatim 409 refusal, walled disabled with reason, operator live, flagged kernel, unlisted kernel, unreadable list, writable package, failed ledger read.
- New `ResourceEditPage.actionLedgerSwitch-34724.test.tsx` (5 tests): switch plus POST to `/showcase_task/send_reminder`, object-less `global`, kernel none (and no ledger read), writable none, and an app area showing a kernel package's item none (ablation: judging the area's package instead turns it red).
- `BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566.test.tsx` gains a describe of 5 cases: one action, several actions, more than three, flows and actions, flows only. Ablation: dropping the named links turns 2 red; dropping the count's action target turned 2 red on the previous commit.
- L2 M1 pins: `DataPillar.actionDeepLink-34724.test.tsx` (3 cases on the real pillar: `?action=` opens the Actions view on that action, not the first; without it Records as before; read once). Ablation: dropping the hook call turns 2 red. Three landing cases (an embedded action's count, mixed named links, no object read without a switched-off action) and the panel row; a pure `customizationRowsOf` case pins both links, the standalone and the embedded. Ablation: the panel's old item link turns 2 red.
- `action-activation.test.ts` pins `ACTION_KERNEL_PACKAGE_SCOPES` to the package doors' `READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES` (L2 N3).
- CI on the first head was red in two pins this PR had missed, both fixed: `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` counts the admin's served Setup tree 31, not 33 (`nav_packaged_actions` and the `group_apps` group it alone held collapse), and `appRouteMetadataReads.ts` declares the packaged-actions redirect route's reads (`NONE`).
- ui: the affected app-shell directories plus the `@object-ui/i18n` suite, all green; platform-objects 41 files / 819 tests green; the `types`, `objectql`, `runtime` and `cli` pins green.
- Type-check: app-shell `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0. eslint on the changed ui files: exit 0, no warning on a changed line.

## Gates (head `5122812f3e`)

`5122812f3e` is one commit on `8390b4f5fb`, the fix for the seat's L2 S4: `useSurfaceDeepLinkMirror` drops `?action=` whenever the surface it writes differs from the URL's `?surface=` (its first write after a deep link names the same object and keeps it), so a reload or a shared copy after picking another object never opens that object on an action view. Pinned on the real Data pillar in `DataPillar.actionDeepLink-34724.test.tsx`; ablating the drop turns the pin red. The 126 app-shell test files that touch `surface`/`nav`/`view`/deep links (1252 tests) pass; app-shell `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0; eslint exit 0, no warning on a changed line.

Console `pnpm build` on the first head, then `node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` from `ui/`: `i18n-locale-en` 60.2 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling (61,603 gzip bytes), ✅; aggregate eager closure 1894.0 KB / 2431.6 KB. The ceiling is not edited.

## Platform actions already switched off (maintainer ruling 6944409840)

The retired page's collector listed every action whose package id was not `sys_metadata`, kernel packages' actions included, and the write door does not refuse them, so a deployment can already hold `active: false` rows for platform actions (measurement: card comment 6943920659). The maintainer ruled A on comment 6944409840: those rows stay in force, with no boot or upgrade step and no door change. In this PR:

- `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem('action', { platform: true })` (`packages/types`) names the activation door instead of Studio: "…An administrator can turn it on again through the action activation API (POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/<object>/<action> with {"enabled": true}; Studio has no switch for the platform's own actions), or you can use another action."
- `ActionActivationProjection` (`packages/objectql`) keeps the package each switched-off row names (`disabledPackageOf`), and `ObjectQL.describeDisabledAction` asks for the platform sentence when the registry's installed manifest for that package has scope `system` or `cloud`. The scope list is spelled locally in `engine-actions.ts`, because `./core` must not import `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (ADR-0076 D2; `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts` and `check:lean-entry-closure` both caught a first draft that did).
- The changeset gives the per-deployment query (a `hasMore: true` answer means incomplete) and the recovery `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/<object>/<action>` with `{"enabled": true}`.
- ADR-0146 D4's amendment records the ruling.
- Pins: `packaged-item-turned-off.test.ts` (platform sentence byte-exact; flow ignores the option), `action-activation.test.ts` (a kernel row gets the door sentence, an app row the Studio one, a package-less row the Studio one; ablating the judgement turns it red), and `api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts` (live `sys_user` `ban_user`, a plugin-auth `system` action, now reads the door sentence).

## Deviations

- The `packagedAutomation.*` console locale keys the retired page read are left in place (not read any more) for a later sweep, so `locales/*` stay byte-identical.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` is a historical log and is left unchanged.
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-{3,4}.mdx` mention the page historically and are left unchanged.
